title: Making Plans with Friends

expressions.example: Can I take a rain check on dinner tonight?
Let's pencil in Saturday for the movie.
We should catch up this weekend.
Sorry for the short notice, can we meet tomorrow?

sentences: She is having lunch with friends on Friday.
We are going to the party on Saturday.
Are you coming to the meetup?
They are visiting us on Sunday.
Is she joining us for dinner?

grammar.title: Present Continuous Para o Futuro
rules: Usa-se o present continuous para planos futuros já combinados: I am meeting Ana tomorrow.
Estrutura: subject + am/is/are + verb-ing: She is having lunch with friends on Friday.
Geralmente vem acompanhado de uma expressão de tempo futuro: tomorrow, next weekend, on Saturday.
